entities.name: Kira
entities.description: An infamous kami of Kamigawa that wards itself and others against spells with magical glass; a small humanoid fish-like creature in a ward bubble.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where Kira is a kami.

events.summary: A samurai tried to strike Kira's bubble but her sword shattered into countless pieces.
events.quote: instead her sword shattered into countless pieces
